crossRefs.note: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored…
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

translations.web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
translations.bsb: A foolish son is his father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
translations.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
translations.asv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
